diff --git a/src/_pytest/id_preview.py b/src/_pytest/id_preview.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..a82f3e929
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/_pytest/id_preview.py
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+"""Single-line ASCII display labels for string and bytes parameter values."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+
+_CONTROL_ESCAPES = {ord("\t"): "\\t", ord("\n"): "\\n", ord("\r"): "\\r"}
+
+
+def _escape_code_point(code: int, *, is_bytes: bool) -> str:
+    if 32 <= code < 127:
+        return chr(code)
+    if code in _CONTROL_ESCAPES:
+        return _CONTROL_ESCAPES[code]
+    if is_bytes or code <= 0xFF:
+        return f"\\x{code:02x}"
+    if code <= 0xFFFF:
+        return f"\\u{code:04x}"
+    return f"\\U{code:08x}"
+
+
+def _preview(value: str | bytes) -> str:
+    if isinstance(value, bytes):
+        return "".join(_escape_code_point(b, is_bytes=True) for b in value)
+    return "".join(_escape_code_point(ord(c), is_bytes=False) for c in value)
+
+
+def id_preview(values: Iterable[str | bytes]) -> list[str]:
+    r"""Return a single-line, ASCII-only display label for each value.
+
+    Labels have no surrounding quotes. Printable ASCII is kept unchanged,
+    tab, newline and carriage return are shown as ``\t``, ``\n`` and ``\r``,
+    and other control characters as ``\xNN``. Non-ASCII characters in
+    strings use Python unicode escapes (``\xNN``, ``\uNNNN``, ``\UNNNNNNNN``),
+    while bytes are escaped byte by byte, without decoding them as UTF-8::
+
+        >>> id_preview(["a\tb", "caf\u00e9", b"caf\xc3\xa9", ""])
+        ['a\\tb', 'caf\\xe9', 'caf\\xc3\\xa9', '']
+    """
+    result = []
+    for value in values:
+        if not isinstance(value, (str, bytes)):
+            raise TypeError(
+                f"id_preview() expects str or bytes values, got {type(value).__name__}"
+            )
+        result.append(_preview(value))
+    return result
diff --git a/testing/test_id_preview.py b/testing/test_id_preview.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..3f8595be2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_id_preview.py
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from _pytest.id_preview import id_preview
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("value", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("", ""),
+        (b"", ""),
+        ("hello world", "hello world"),
+        (b"hello world", "hello world"),
+        ("a\\b'\"", "a\\b'\""),
+        (b"a\\b'\"", "a\\b'\""),
+        ("a\tb\nc\rd", "a\\tb\\nc\\rd"),
+        (b"a\tb\nc\rd", "a\\tb\\nc\\rd"),
+        ("\x00\x1b\x7f", "\\x00\\x1b\\x7f"),
+        (b"\x00\x1b\x7f", "\\x00\\x1b\\x7f"),
+        ("caf\u00e9", "caf\\xe9"),
+        ("\u3028\u15fd", "\\u3028\\u15fd"),
+        ("\U0001f600", "\\U0001f600"),
+        ("caf\u00e9".encode(), "caf\\xc3\\xa9"),
+        (b"\xff\x80", "\\xff\\x80"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_id_preview_single(value: str | bytes, expected: str) -> None:
+    assert id_preview([value]) == [expected]
+
+
+def test_id_preview_preserves_order_and_empty_values() -> None:
+    values = iter(["b", b"", "", b"a\n", "\u00e9"])
+    assert id_preview(values) == ["b", "", "", "a\\n", "\\xe9"]
+
+
+def test_id_preview_output_is_single_line_ascii() -> None:
+    values = ["".join(map(chr, range(0x300))), bytes(range(256))]
+    for label in id_preview(values):
+        assert label.isascii()
+        assert label.isprintable()
+        assert "\n" not in label and "\r" not in label
+
+
+def test_id_preview_empty() -> None:
+    assert id_preview([]) == []
+
+
+def test_id_preview_rejects_other_types() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="got int"):
+        id_preview([1])  # type: ignore[list-item]
notes:
Added src/_pytest/id_preview.py with a per-code-point escaper (printable ASCII kept, \t/\n/\r, \xNN for other controls and bytes, \xNN/\uNNNN/\UNNNNNNNN for non-ASCII str), so backslashes stay unchanged unlike compat.ascii_escaped; tests in testing/test_id_preview.py.
